reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: Заказываю уже не в первый раз! Нравится продукт и его эффект. У меня жирная кожа и этот крем не защищает от жирного блеска на 100%, но все же сдерживает его по сравнению с другими средствами спф.
reviews.zh: 我已經唔係第一次買！鍾意呢件產品同佢嘅效果。我係油性肌，呢支防曬霜唔可以100%防止油光，但係同其他防曬產品比起嚟，佢仍然控制得到。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: "Excellent facial sunscreen. It feels pleasant on the skin, absorbs easily, and doesn't leave a heavy feeling. Highly recommended!"
reviews.zh: 極好嘅面部防曬霜。喺皮膚上面感覺舒服，吸收得快，又唔會有厚重嘅感覺。非常推薦！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: made me break out pretty bad in areas i've never broken out from before, also not good for oily skin but it leaves no cast and is pretty light
reviews.zh: 令我爆瘡爆得好勁，喺啲以前從來冇爆過嘅位置都爆，仲有唔啱油性肌，不過就唔會泛白，而且質地幾輕。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: I have sensitive, dry, combination, and eczema prone skin. This sunscreen is light, gentle, moisturizing, soothing, with a silky texture. There is no scent and it doesn’t leave a white cast. I love that it contains rice and probiotics. It leaves my skin dewy and glowy. It’s now my current favorite sunscreen. I had to order the 1+1 after trying it!
reviews.zh: 我係敏感肌、乾肌、混合性肌，同埋容易有濕疹嘅皮膚。呢支防曬霜質地輕、溫和、保濕、舒緩，絲滑質感。冇香味，又唔會泛白。我鍾意佢含有米同益生菌。用完之後皮膚水光亮澤。佢而家係我最愛嘅防曬霜。試完之後我即刻要落單1+1！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: This is a good sunscreen to use if you have dry skin. It leaves a dewy finish so if u have natural oily skin I don’t think it would be the best for you. I have dark skin and I have found that it leaves a slight white cast but u just have to rub it in a little more to get rid of it. Overall I really like this product!
reviews.zh: 如果你係乾肌，呢支係一支好嘅防曬霜。佢有水光妝效，所以如果你係天身油肌，我覺得佢未必最適合你。我係深膚色，發現佢會有少少泛白，不過只要再大力啲搓開就會散。整體嚟講我真係好鍾意呢件產品！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: Consistencia muy ligera y súper hidratante, al final queda un glow muy potente y bonito aunque en lugares calurosos, con el tiempo hace parecer grasa en la cara. No tiene fragancia y el empaque es pequeño. Así es como queda mi piel después de usarlo junto con una rutina completa de los productos de Beauty of Joseon.
reviews.zh: 質地非常輕，超級保濕，最後呈現出好強勁又靚嘅光澤，雖然喺熱嘅地方，時間耐咗會令塊面睇起上嚟好油。冇香味，包裝細細盒。配搭 Beauty of Joseon 全套產品一齊用之後，我嘅皮膚就係咁嘅效果。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen. The texture, the sun protection, and the overall skin benefits are absolutely AMAZING! At first I was a little skeptical, since it went viral on Tik tok and I don't usually tend to like skincare products that go viral. I decided to try it out since my old sunscreen (the roundLAB one) actually broke me out. I find the sunscreen really soaks into my skin well and doesn't make it feel sticky or greasy (like my supergoop play one). I feel like the most amazing part of this suncreen is how great my skin has improved after! It's smoother, brighter, and a lot more moisturized!
reviews.zh: 我絕對超級鍾意呢支防曬霜。質地、防曬效果，仲有整體對皮膚嘅好處都係無敵！一開始我有啲懷疑，因為佢喺 TikTok 突然爆紅，我通常都唔係好鍾意嗰啲爆紅嘅護膚品。舊嗰支防曬（即係 roundLAB 嗰支）令我爆瘡，所以我決定試吓。我發現呢支防曬真係好好滲入皮膚，唔會有黏笠或者油笠嘅感覺（好似我支 supergoop play 咁）。我覺得最神奇嘅係用完之後皮膚改善咗好多！更滑、更亮、保濕度大增！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun : Rice + Probiotics 50mL
reviews.text: I needed a new sunscreen and saw that there was all this hype over this one so I wanted to give it a try. I'm glad I got it because it's really one of the best sunscreen I have ever tried. It doesn't have that strong sunscreen smell, which I REALLY like. It's so smooth and goes on your skin like a regular lotion. I used to break out after using a different sunscreen but my skin seems to enjoy this one. Highly recommended for those with sensitive skin!
reviews.zh: 我需要一支新嘅防曬霜，見到呢支咁hit，所以想試吓。好慶幸買咗，因為佢真係我用過最好嘅防曬之一。佢冇嗰種勁嘅防曬味，我真係好鍾意。佢好滑，搽上皮膚就好似普通潤膚乳咁。我以前用其他防曬會爆瘡，但我塊皮膚好似好鍾意呢一支。敏感肌嘅人非常推薦！
